main_text.head: לד

לָדִין ad judicandum, pro לָדִין Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. דון.
main_text.head: לה
main_text.p: לָדַת parere, לְלֶדֶת ad pariendum, מְלֶדֶת à pariendo, לְדָתָהּ parere eam, בְּלְדָתָהּ in parere eam, לְלֵדְתִּי me, לְדָתָנָה eas, Inf. Kal, præf. aff. Rad. יָלַד.

page.notes: Hebrew letters are transcribed from the scan at low resolution; vowel points and some consonants in the Hebrew headwords and forms are uncertain and were not checked against a larger image. The running head and the right-column heading "לה" are Hebrew letters and may be catchwords rather than running heads. The entry "לְהַמִּיתוֹ ... eum," continues on the next page. Long s rendered as plain s throughout.
